fields.description: La Tilia is a three- and four-bedroom townhouse development in Villanova, Dubailand. Its plans offer both two-storey and roof-level family-room layouts. This profile keeps the original project’s commercial references separate from later La Tilia releases.

overview: The plans distinguish two-storey homes from layouts with an additional roof-level family room and terrace. Four-bedroom drawings show a ground-floor guest bedroom and double-volume living space.
Landscaped pedestrian sikkas connect the homes; facilities shown in the brochure belong to the community rather than being private inclusions in every townhouse.
research.locationNote: Villanova, Dubailand, Dubai. The developer identifies Emirates Road access with links to Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road and Al Ain Road. No fixed travel-time promise or approximate map coordinate is used.
research.priceNote: The historic broker-hosted branded sheet lists AED 2.69m for three-bedroom and AED 2.99m for four-bedroom homes. These are launch references, not available-unit quotations. Property Finder retains AED 2.69m in its overview but displays a rounded AED 2.7m dynamic guide; its collection index showed AED 2.73m. The original project is marked sold out, which does not establish current resale stock.
research.paymentNote: The broker-hosted original sheet totals 60% before handover and 40% at handover, including 10% booking. Its historical dates are shown below. Property Finder corroborates the 10/50/40 split. A resale may have a different outstanding balance; obtain the selected home’s original contract and account statement.
research.handoverNote: The historic branded sheet, retrieved from a broker-hosted public copy, estimates September 2028 completion. Property Finder gives Q3 2028, with August 2028 in its key information and 21 August in its timeline. These forecasts differ at month level. No current primary contractual date was verified, so the headline remains unconfirmed.

facts.label: Construction award · 14 April 2026
facts.value: The parent company announced a nearly AED 1.1bn contract covering 850 homes across La Tilia phases 1 and 2: 410 in phase 1 and 440 in phase 2. The combined mix is 500 three-bedroom and 350 four-bedroom townhouses. These counts are not current availability.

unresolved: Confirm selected-unit availability, price, contractual date, dated instalments, outstanding balance and resale eligibility before committing. No current inventory feed or contractual schedule was verified.

Plan totals are published marketing areas, not plot sizes or independently measured net interiors. Visible 4B1/4B2 totals differ by 0.01 sq ft from embedded drawing text; confirm contractual measurements. Mirrored versions do not represent additional bedroom types.

Service charges, cooling bills, final specifications, transaction costs and individual title/escrow details require current primary documentation. No guaranteed yield, visa eligibility or completion percentage is asserted.
